mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona Community Park with temperatures at 64 degrees. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible at 5:13 AM, rising over Mount Horeb in the west and traveling low across the horizon toward Belleville in the south.

Regarding city updates, the Verona Police Department is investigating a case involving a school staff member arrested on Friday, September 4. Additionally, road work on Highway M moves into phase two this week, requiring traffic shifts, while the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is set to begin with trail closures between Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting in mid-September.

There is plenty to do in our city, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can join a yoga class at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights throughout next week at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, and The Mill, plus the farmer's market on Tuesday at Hometown Junction Park.

Regarding the weekly report, on Sunday, August 30, the school district informed the police department of an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019, leading to an arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit to grab this treat.
